cases.prompt_condition:
7P5R_2: POST-CUTOFF D-PROTEIN/D-PEPTIDE STRUCTURE TASK.

Input contract:
- Model the curated D entity: D-Lacticin Q.
- Use this sequence exactly for the representative modeled chain: MAGFLKVVQLLAKYGSKAVQWAWANKGKILDWLNAGQAIDWVVSKIKQILGIK
- Preserve residue order, residue count, chain identity, and standard backbone atoms N, CA, C, O.
- Preserve CB for every standard non-Gly residue; Gly is achiral and excluded from chirality scoring.
- PDB chain context: PDB asym chains=['C', 'D']; author chains=['CCC', 'DDD']; representative AF3 chain may be normalized to Chain A for single-entity evaluation.

Chirality rule:
Every standard non-Gly residue assigned to the D entity must be D-like under the signed-volume convention:
signed_volume = dot(cross(N - CA, C - CA), CB - CA) < 0.
Residue names or CCD codes alone are insufficient; coordinates must satisfy the signed-volume rule.
X or other unsupported non-standard residues should be preserved when possible but excluded from chirality scoring unless CCD support is available.

Structural objective:
This is a all_D_racemic_crystallography benchmark case. Preserve the reference fold/topology and internal C-alpha distance/contact map as much as possible while enforcing D-like chirality.

Hard negative constraints:
- Do not simply rename L residues as D residues.
- Do not delete residues or atoms to avoid chirality errors.
- Do not sacrifice reference fold/contact-map preservation merely to satisfy local chirality.
- If required atoms or expected chains are missing, label the output FAIL_NOT_EVALUABLE.

cases.prompt_condition:
8P6Q_2: POST-CUTOFF D-PROTEIN/D-PEPTIDE STRUCTURE TASK.

Input contract:
- Model the curated D entity: D-TNFR-1 CRD2.
- Use this sequence exactly for the representative modeled chain: SCSKCRKEMGQVEISSCTVDRDTVCGCRKNQYRHYWSENLFQCFN
- Preserve residue order, residue count, chain identity, and standard backbone atoms N, CA, C, O.
- Preserve CB for every standard non-Gly residue; Gly is achiral and excluded from chirality scoring.
- PDB chain context: PDB asym chains=['B']; author chains=['B']; representative AF3 chain may be normalized to Chain A for single-entity evaluation.

Chirality rule:
Every standard non-Gly residue assigned to the D entity must be D-like under the signed-volume convention:
signed_volume = dot(cross(N - CA, C - CA), CB - CA) < 0.
Residue names or CCD codes alone are insufficient; coordinates must satisfy the signed-volume rule.
X or other unsupported non-standard residues should be preserved when possible but excluded from chirality scoring unless CCD support is available.

Structural objective:
This is a all_D_racemic_crystallography benchmark case. Preserve the reference fold/topology and internal C-alpha distance/contact map as much as possible while enforcing D-like chirality.

Hard negative constraints:
- Do not simply rename L residues as D residues.
- Do not delete residues or atoms to avoid chirality errors.
- Do not sacrifice reference fold/contact-map preservation merely to satisfy local chirality.
- If required atoms or expected chains are missing, label the output FAIL_NOT_EVALUABLE.
cases.baseline_input: Representative standard L sequence, no D modifications and no mirror/stereochemical instruction.
cases.mirror_axis: not_fixed; reflection axis is evaluator-defined if mirror RMSD is computed

json_correction_log.correction_purpose: Complete D-residue CCD annotations for AF3/AT-AF input generation. The previous d_ccd_codes field was partly copied from PDB container-level detected monomers and could miss standard D residues required by an all-D sequence, especially DAL in 7QDI_1 and 8BFD_2.
json_correction_log.correction_rule: For each case, regenerate standard D CCD codes from sequence and d_residue_position_indices_1_based; append missing standard codes to d_ccd_codes; add an explicit d_residue_types_by_position_1_based map.
